newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso trades hit record high.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso trades hit record high.

text.p: Trades on the computerised Philippine peso/U.S. dollar trades hit an intraday record high of $492 million in volatile trading on Friday.
It exceeded the $446.3 million worth of trades on January 9 when the peso was also hammered after interest rates fell sharply after a reserve requirement cut.

The peso has been hit by speculation from the spillover effects of the problems of the Thai baht, forcing the Central Bank to raise its key overnight borrowing rate by seven percentage points to 20 percent on Friday.
Banks are now dumping their dollars after the Central Bank's action, which saw the peso rise to 26.368 after opening at 26.375 pesos.
